title: Elon Musk: one last rocket (kinetic Short)

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Elon Musk is about to lose everything.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: His rocket company has tried to reach orbit three times.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Tesla is bleeding cash. The economy is collapsing.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And the man who wants to put humans on Mars is borrowing money from friends to pay rent.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He has money for one more launch. Just one.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And this time, it reaches orbit.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Three months later, NASA calls. A 1.6 billion dollar contract.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The next day, on Christmas Eve, Tesla closes its funding round, days before it would have gone bankrupt.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Today, the guy who almost lost it all is the first trillionaire in history.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: All because of one last rocket.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The full story is on Unfiled Films.
